This file is the secret scanner's canary. It is not a credential.

The CI "Scan for secrets" step copies the line below into a scratch directory
and scans it BEFORE scanning the working tree. If the scan of this line comes
back clean, the scanner is broken and its verdict on the real tree means
nothing, so the job fails there rather than reporting a pass it did not earn.

That check exists because the scan it guards already failed this way once: a
shallow checkout made the commit range unresolvable, and gitleaks reported
"no leaks found" after scanning zero bytes.

The value is a syntactically valid Stripe publishable key that was never
issued. It lives at this path -- not under testing/fixtures/ -- so that the
allowlist entry keeping it out of the tree scan covers infrastructure rather
than widening what a captured fixture is allowed to contain.

stripe_key = "pk_live_51H8xQ2Kj9mNpQrStUvWxYz01"
